spec.name: Grammar sampler — retain superseded R2 screen
spec.description: Archive completed raw cells from the intentionally canceled revision-2 diagnostic. No inference, timing or qualification. Revision 3 uses fresh source, matched instrumentation and all 30 new qualification blocks.

runtime.command:
set -eu
cd '/Users/gi/Library/Application Support/jianyang/work/run_jd9p57k5k5vgppr/workspace/candidate'
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 3c74374b1ed0209ade737815ca45e0b58db7a8eb
mkdir -p "$JIANYANG_ARTIFACT_DIR"
FOUND=0
for directory in .deps/grammar-development.*; do
  if test -d "$directory"; then
    test "$FOUND" = 0
    cp "$directory/observations.jsonl" "$JIANYANG_ARTIFACT_DIR/superseded-r2-observations.jsonl"
    cp "$directory/admitted-fixtures.json" "$JIANYANG_ARTIFACT_DIR/superseded-r2-fixtures.json"
    FOUND=1
  fi
done
test "$FOUND" = 1
shasum -a 256 "$JIANYANG_ARTIFACT_DIR/"* > /tmp/grammar-r2-retention-$$.txt
cp /tmp/grammar-r2-retention-$$.txt "$JIANYANG_ARTIFACT_DIR/artifact-hashes.txt"
rm /tmp/grammar-r2-retention-$$.txt
printf 'Retained superseded R2 raw evidence; no metrics accepted.\n'
